Synchronous abort reentry: pass reserved before abort, immediate abort outcome retained
Any independent async obligation still pending: all other obligations have started; repeats share in-flight pass, no timeout success or duplicate attempt
Late adopted Sync after synchronous constructor reentry: next microtask pass includes actual registered handle
Repeated permanent unsubscribe/cache/channel failure: live cleanup obligation retained, admission cannot reopen
Callback directly returning the current disposal pass: reject self-dependency; do not mark role fulfilled
Successful cleanup after a failed attempt: diagnostics retain original first/latest causes while command state advances only after real return
